candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether rebounds, renewed weakness, and relative ETH performance persisted or reversed, and whether price deterioration preceded or followed other observations. This directly addresses repeated uncertainty about path ordering and mismatched horizon endpoints.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews report only selected rolling windows and ETH/BTC hourly closes; weekly reviews repeatedly lack underlying price paths, rebound magnitudes, and freeze-time sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamp-aligned BTC and ETH price path with derived ETH/BTC series
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse endpoint returns and incomplete or non-aligned hourly observations cannot reconstruct intraperiod paths or establish what was observable at each review cutoff.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish sustained participation deterioration or recovery from isolated snapshots, while making changes in constituent membership visible. This bears on competing broad-participation and narrow-leadership explanations.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews describe proxy breadth snapshots with changing point-in-time membership; weekly reviews repeatedly lack numerical breadth sequences and note that proxy observations do not establish sustained participation.
candidates.missing_history_problem: A few snapshots with changing membership cannot establish whether breadth improved or deteriorated persistently, or whether apparent changes reflect the measured universe.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish the direction and persistence of settled BTC and ETH ETF flows across the review periods, helping assess whether reported mixed or negative sessions were isolated or part of a sustained sequence.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple reviews explicitly distinguish a latest settled session from a flow sequence and note that the most recent supplied settled-flow detail was stale relative to the reviewed week.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session rows or stale weekly detail cannot establish within-period flow persistence, divergence, or timing relative to price and breadth changes.
